device_entry.name_en: A2D 4-Channel Isolated ADC Voltage Measurement Module

device_entry.description: 这是一款带四路隔离输入的模数转换电压采集模块，可通过 RS485 通讯读取多通道电压，并支持校准参数管理与状态指示灯控制。适用于实验室中的多路电压监测、传感器信号采集和电隔离测量场景。
device_entry.description_en: This is a four-channel isolated ADC-based voltage acquisition module that reads multiple voltage inputs over RS485 and supports calibration management and LED status indication. It is suitable for laboratory use in multi-channel voltage monitoring, sensor signal acquisition, and electrically isolated measurements.
